tuition.note: Per semester, Ankara, Engineering/Architecture/sciences (800 USD per semester for social sciences/economics); 2026-2027 table

requirement.text: Apply online as international applicant with secondary qualification results (e.g. A-levels, SAT, IB); English score not required to apply, but admitted students without valid TOEFL/PTE score take METU English Proficiency Exam or one-year prep. IELTS taken after 24 Dec 2022 not accepted.
